hero.companyName:
KAZ-NDT-SERVICE —
your reliable partner in quality control
hero.desc1: Certified NDT services at TCO and KPO facilities
hero.desc2: Non-destructive testing of welds for key projects in Kazakhstan's oil and gas sector
hero.desc3: Full range of NDT services, licenses for working with IIC, experience at Tengiz and Karachaganak
hero.desc4: Comprehensive NDT services according to ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 9001, ISO 14001 standards

info.about1: LLP 'KAZ-NDT-SERVICE' is accredited by the National Accreditation Center according to the GOST ISO/IEC 17025-2019 standard 'General requirements for the competence of testing and calibration laboratories', and also holds the following certificates:
info.line1: certificate ST RK ISO 9001-2016 'Quality management systems. Requirements';
info.line2: certificate ST RK OHSAS 18001-2008 'Occupational health and safety management systems. Requirements';
info.line3: certificate ST RK ISO 14001-2016 'Environmental management systems. Requirements and guidance for use'.
info.about2:
The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Atyrau.
We are a 100% Kazakhstani company.
The company has all necessary licenses for working with sources of ionizing radiation, transportation and handling of radioactive materials and equipment containing radioactive materials.
Currently, we operate at the Tengiz and Karachaganak fields.
We have passed pre-qualification and have access to work on projects of LLP 'Tengizchevroil' (TCO) and 'Karachaganak Petroleum Operating b.v.' (KPO).

footer.description: Since 2014, we have been providing reliable non-destructive testing at oil and gas facilities. We operate according to international standards of quality, safety, and environmental friendliness. Our competencies are confirmed by accreditations and experience on the largest projects in the country.

about.title: About Us
about.point1: LLP 'KAZ-NDT-SERVICE' provides non-destructive testing services for welds on projects in the oil and gas industry.
about.point2: The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Atyrau. We are a 100% Kazakhstani company.
about.point3: The company has all necessary licenses for working with sources of ionizing radiation (gamma and X-ray), transportation and handling of radioactive materials and equipment containing radioactive materials.
about.point4: Currently, we operate at the Tengiz and Karachaganak fields. We have passed pre-qualification and have access to work on projects of LLP 'Tengizchevroil' (TCO) and 'Karachaganak Petroleum Operating b.v.' (KPO).
about.expertiseDescription: LLP 'KAZ-NDT-SERVICE' is accredited by the National Accreditation Center according to the GOST ISO/IEC 17025-2019 standard 'General requirements for the competence of testing and calibration laboratories', and also holds certificates:
about.expertisePoint1: certificate ST RK ISO 9001-2016 'Quality management systems. Requirements';
about.expertisePoint2: certificate ST RK OHSAS 18001-2008 'Occupational health and safety management systems. Requirements';
about.expertisePoint3: certificate ST RK ISO 14001-2016 'Environmental management systems. Requirements and guidance for use'.
about.equipmentDescription1: There is an in-house laboratory accredited by the National Accreditation Center (NCA) as a mobile testing laboratory for technical diagnostics and non-destructive testing (MTL TD and NDT).
about.equipmentDescription2: The laboratories are equipped with storage facilities for sources of ionizing radiation and equipment necessary for the following types of testing:
about.equipmentPoint9: Inspection of geometric welded joints (LT, vacuuming).
about.labsDescription: Our laboratories are accredited to conduct testing of:
about.labPoint1: vessels operating under pressure of steam, gas, flammable and toxic liquids;
about.labPoint2: seamless steel pipes for oil refining and petrochemical industries;
about.labPoint3: seamless steel pipes of hot forming;
about.labPoint4: seamless steel pipes of cold forming;
about.labPoint5: seamless stainless steel pipes with hot and cold forming;
about.labPoint6: seamless stainless steel pipes for energy;
